Full summary: Plugin 1.12.0: bundled server pin ^1.20.0 → ^2.0.0, superseding the quiet-week gate on Dave's field evidence of dual-server version skew. Repo .mcp.json flipped @next → @latest, deny updated in lockstep, new CI job mcp-deny-sync enforces the lockstep. UPGRADE-v2/README rewritten for stable.
Decisions: Bumped the plugin server pin to ^2.0.0 now (plugin 1.12.0) instead of waiting the planned quiet week after stable — supersedes the stable-cut decision to leave both pins untouched. Rationale: 2.0.0 is code-identical to beta.3 (11 days of soak), so the wait added no signal, while the dual-server version skew has demonstrated field cost (Dave hit it during beta; the deniedMcpServers avoidance is exact-command-match brittle) and worsens post-stable: a project migrated to format version 2 turns a 1.x plugin server read-only with broken hooks.; Kept this repo's .mcp.json sh -lc wrapper entry (flipped @next → @latest) plus the deny, rather than deleting both and adopting the plugin's bundled server — cmux split-pane teammates spawn with minimal PATH, the plugin's bare-npx command cannot be wrapped (Windows compat, upstream #9427), so dropping .mcp.json would reintroduce silently-absent twining for teammates.; Converted the brittle deny-vs-pin coupling into a CI-enforced invariant: new mcp-deny-sync job fails whenever .claude/settings.json deniedMcpServers drifts from plugin/.mcp.json's exact server command — chosen over documenting the coupling (already documented, still got called incredibly brittle) and over structural fixes (single-instance server guard) which are v2.1-scale product work.; Chose plugin minor bump 1.11.3 → 1.12.0 for the pin change — dependency major flip in behavior, not a patch.
Findings: need: structural fix for plugin-bundled vs project-pinned dual twining servers — exact-command deny is inherently fragile and per-repo. Candidates: server-side single-instance guard per project (second instance detects dashboard port/lock, skips dashboard, or exits cleanly), or upstream env expansion in plugin .mcp.json (anthropics/claude-code#9427). v2.1 design territory alongside #32/#33.
